review_scope: Ability setup, impact, aftermath, caster identity, target identity, and counterplay readability

findings.finding: Overlapping green and red rings, a purple aura, and ground sigils show activity but do not link one caster to one target or ability.
Near-identical purple and pink treatments do not distinguish healing, shielding, and stunning at gameplay scale.
The sequence primarily changes positions and status bars; it does not expose a legible anticipation, hit, and residue arc.
The arena-pressure banner supplies meaning through text while occluding the battlefield, substituting UI explanation for in-world causality.

limitations: The screenshots are historical and do not establish current runtime quality.
Still images cannot assess timing, sound, motion trails, response, or anticipation frames.
Fresh capture was blocked by missing Godot imported font and audio cache artifacts.
Automated annotation was blocked because the visual_debug_harness Python module was unavailable.
